sources.title: Safeguarding information and maps for HS2
sources.facts: Collects current HS2 safeguarding maps and information for protected route land.
sources.guard: A safeguarding map does not prove a parcel is acquired, required, developable, compensated or approved.

sources.title: HS2 safeguarding for developers and local authorities
sources.facts: Explains route-map checks, consultation duties and current safeguarding directions for developers and planning authorities.
sources.guard: Consultation requirements do not prove planning refusal, permission, blight eligibility or scheme delivery.

sources.title: East West Rail safeguarding directions
sources.facts: Updated directions require specified planning applications in safeguarded land to be referred to East West Rail Company.
sources.guard: Directions protect land from conflicting development but do not prove funding, final alignment, construction or acquisition.

sources.title: Bakerloo line extension: safeguarding directions
sources.facts: Sets consultation directions and maps for land potentially required for the proposed Bakerloo line extension.
sources.guard: Safeguarding does not represent a funding commitment or prove that the extension will be delivered.

sources.title: National Networks National Policy Statement
sources.facts: Provides the assessment framework for nationally significant road, rail and strategic rail-freight projects accepted after 24 May 2024.
sources.guard: National policy does not prove a specific project has consent, finance, land, environmental acceptability or delivery.

sources.title: Safer Railway Scheme
sources.facts: Sets national standards and assessment criteria for rail organisations seeking safety, security and safeguarding accreditation.
sources.guard: A scheme or accreditation framework does not prove a location, operator or project is safe or accredited.

sources.title: ROGS
sources.facts: Explains the regulatory regime and minimum safety-management requirements for railways and guided transport systems.
sources.guard: Regulatory guidance does not prove a duty holder has obtained authorisation or is compliant at a specific site.

sources.title: Goal-setting principles for railway health and safety
sources.facts: Sets ORR expectations for railway design, operation, maintenance, resilience and whole-life risk control.
sources.guard: High-level principles do not prove design acceptance, safe operation, capacity, planning consent or delivery.
